如果此书侵犯了您的权益，请点击访问作者版权投诉快速通道    “小姐，楚先生说了，林逸先生是个复合型人才，能文能武，这个区区挡箭牌自然不在话下……”
福伯连忙解释道。
为了怕楚梦瑶担心，有些事情楚鹏展并没有告诉她，也嘱咐了福伯不要告诉她。
请林逸来表面上是照顾楚梦瑶的学习和生活，其实却是有另一个深远的含义，牵扯到家里面老一辈人的一个约定……
但是显然，如果冷不丁的弄个伴读出来，楚梦瑶肯定不会同意的。
不过恰巧楚梦瑶为了应付一些追求她的人而疲于劳心，所以就找到楚鹏展，让他帮忙雇佣一个挡箭牌过来，帮着自己挡掉身边的这些苍蝇。
于是，楚鹏展就连蒙带骗的将林逸当成了挡箭牌推荐给了楚梦瑶。
可是……福伯真有点儿后悔没带着林逸去服装店好好的打扮一下，根据福伯从照片上看来，林逸长得还是挺精神的，只是这造型实在有点儿别致，不能适合这身边的环境……
“他？”
楚梦瑶怎么也看不出眼前这男人有什么特别之处，不会是父亲随便从人力市场找来的刚进城务工的民工吧？
楚梦瑶一旁的那个女孩子却是捂嘴偷笑了起来，因为林逸这打扮，怎么看也不像是能替楚梦瑶做挡箭牌的人。
“小舒，你笑什么？”
楚梦瑶对于老爸的敷衍，本就气得不行，见自己的闺中好友居然也在偷笑，顿时气就不打一处来，狠狠的瞪了她一眼。
陈雨舒被楚梦瑶这么一喝斥，忙吐了吐舌头，闭上了嘴巴，不过眼睛却十分好奇的盯着林逸看。
“福伯，叫他下车，我要换人。”
楚梦瑶皱了皱眉，实在不愿意在这个问题上多争论下去。
“小姐，楚先生说了，林逸先生一定可以胜任的，而且已经签署了合同……”
福伯的言下之意就是，你不同意也没办法，楚鹏展已经替你做主了，这事儿无法改变了。
“啊？”
楚梦瑶漂亮的大眼睛眨了眨，都快哭了，真不知道老爸是怎么想的！

与其这样，还不如不找什么挡箭牌了，这个人要是待在自己的身边，岂不是叫人笑死？
本来，如果这个挡箭牌要是长得不错，楚梦瑶还想对外宣称是自己的男朋友呢，毕竟最好的赶走那些苍蝇的方式就是如此了。
不过现在看来显然不可能了。
就算自己说这个土包子是自己的男朋友，也得有人相信才行啊，钟品亮估计都会笑掉大牙。
林逸听着这几个人的对话，顿时一阵头大！
挡箭牌？这小妞不会真要找对象吧？
怪不得之前楚鹏展和自己说话的时候古古怪怪的，莫非真是在招女婿？
“好吧，刚才那边那个男生对我纠缠不放，你帮我处理一下吧，处理的好就算你过关了。”
楚梦瑶眼睛滴溜溜的一转，计上心头来。
反正这家伙要是不会处理，自己就可以用他不称职的理由让老爸开除他了。
“他吗？”
林逸点了点头，下了车，快步的向钟品亮走了过去。
“这个楚梦瑶，每次约她都被拒绝，要是换做别的女人，早就上赶着扑向我的怀抱了！”
钟品亮不爽的和几个跟班抱怨着。
“亮哥，可是这个楚梦瑶不是一般的女人啊，她可是鹏展集团的千金大小姐，有难度也是正常的！”
钟品亮的一个叫高小福的跟班说道。
“我知道，还用你说？”
钟品亮摆了摆手，道：“所以要有恒心……”
钟品亮话还没说完，就看到一个穿着已经有些发黄的白背心土黄裤子的年轻人正飞速的向这边走来，顿时一愣。
林逸快步走到钟品亮的身旁，二话不说，抬起腿就照着他的屁沟处来了一脚，直接给钟品亮踹了一个狗啃泥，趴在了地上。

然后林逸直接转身，头也不回的就径直的向车子这边走了回来。
钟品亮正准备滔滔不绝的发表一下自己对追求楚梦瑶的感想报告呢，正说着高兴，就觉得自己的屁股被人猛地踹了一脚，然后就一个不稳栽倒在了地上。
“谁？不想活了么？敢踢我？”
钟品亮挣扎了半天才从地上爬起来，灰头土脸的大骂道。
“就是刚才那个民工……”
高小福连忙说道。
“那你们还愣着干什么？赶紧追啊！”
钟品亮气急败坏的大喝道：“抓住他，狠狠的打！”
“钟少，他没影了……”
刚才钟品亮被林逸踢倒，几个手下都把注意力放在钟品亮有没有事上面了，结果一转眼的功夫，那个民工就不见了。

content_en:
If this book infringes upon your rights, please click to visit the author's copyright complaint fast track. "Miss, Mr. Chu said that Mr. Lin Yi is a comprehensive talent, capable of both literary and military skills. This is a mere shield..."
Fu Bo quickly explained.
In order to avoid worrying Chu Mengyao, Chu Pengzhan did not tell her some things, and also asked Uncle Fu not to tell her.
On the surface, inviting Lin Yilai was to take care of Chu Mengyao's study and life, but actually it had another far-reaching meaning, involving an agreement made by the older generation of the family...
But obviously, Chu Mengyao would definitely not agree if a companion reading was made out of nowhere.
However, it happened that Chu Mengyao was tired of dealing with some people who were pursuing her, so she approached Chu Pengzhan and asked him to help hire a shield to help her block the flies around her.
Therefore, Chu Pengzhan even deceived Lin Yi and recommended him to Chu Mengyao as a shield.
But... Fu Bo really regrets not taking Lin Yi to the clothing store to dress up properly. According to Fu Bo, Lin Yi looks quite energetic from the photos, but his style is a bit unique and does not suit the surrounding environment...
"Him?"
Chu Mengyao couldn't see anything special about the man in front of her. He couldn't be a migrant worker who had just come to work in the city that his father randomly found from the labor market, right?
The girl next to Chu Mengyao covered her mouth and snickered, because Lin Yi's appearance did not look like someone who could serve as a shield for Chu Mengyao.
"Xiao Shu, why are you laughing?"
Chu Mengyao was already very angry at her father's perfunctory behavior. When she saw that her best friend was also snickering, she suddenly lost her temper and glared at her fiercely.
Chen Yushu was scolded by Chu Mengyao and hurriedly stuck out her tongue and closed her mouth, but her eyes were staring at Lin Yi curiously.
"Uncle Fu, tell him to get out of the car. I want to replace him."
Chu Mengyao frowned, really unwilling to argue on this issue any longer.
"Miss, Mr. Chu said that Mr. Lin Yi will definitely be qualified, and he has already signed the contract..."
The implication of Uncle Fu is that there is nothing you can do if you disagree. Chu Pengzhan has already made the decision for you, and this matter cannot be changed.
"Huh?"
Chu Mengyao blinked her beautiful big eyes and almost cried. She really didn't know what her father was thinking!
Instead of doing this, it would be better not to find any shield. If this person stayed by his side, wouldn't it make people laugh to death?
Originally, if this shield was good-looking, Chu Mengyao would have wanted to claim that he was her boyfriend. After all, this was the best way to get rid of those flies.
But now it seems obviously impossible.
Even if he said that this country bumpkin was his boyfriend, someone would have to believe him. Zhong Pinliang would probably laugh out loud.
Lin Yi suddenly felt dizzy after listening to the conversation between these people!
shield? Is this girl really looking for a partner?
No wonder Chu Pengzhan was acting weird when talking to him before. Could he really be looking for a son-in-law?
"Okay, that boy over there just kept pestering me, please help me deal with it. If you handle it well, you will pass."
Chu Mengyao's eyes rolled around, thinking about it.
Anyway, if this guy doesn't know how to deal with it, he can use his incompetence as a reason to get his father to fire him.
"Him?"
Lin Yi nodded, got out of the car, and walked quickly towards Zhong Pinliang.
"This Chu Mengyao, she gets rejected every time I ask her out. If it were any other woman, she would have rushed into my arms!"
Zhong Pinliang complained unhappily to several followers.
"Brother Liang, this Chu Mengyao is not an ordinary woman. She is the daughter of the Pengzhan Group. It is normal for her to have difficulties!"
One of Zhong Pinliang's followers named Gao Xiaofu said.
"I know, butIn your words? "
Zhong Pinliang waved his hand and said: "So you must have perseverance..."
Before Zhong Pinliang finished speaking, he saw a young man wearing a white vest and khaki trousers that were already a little yellow walking towards this side quickly, and he was suddenly startled.
Lin Yi walked quickly to Zhong Pinliang, without saying a word, raised his leg and kicked him in the butt groove, giving Zhong Pinliang a direct kick and causing him to lie on the ground.
Then Lin Yi turned around and walked straight back to the car without looking back.
Zhong Pinliang was about to give a eloquent report on his feelings about pursuing Chu Mengyao. Just as he was talking happily, he felt his butt was kicked violently, and then he fell unsteadily to the ground.
"Who? Don’t want to live anymore? Dare you kick me? "
Zhong Pinliang struggled for a long time before he got up from the ground, and cursed in disgrace.
"That's the migrant worker just now..."
Gao Xiaofu said quickly.
"Then what are you still doing? Hurry up and chase! "
Zhong Pinliang shouted angrily: "Catch him and beat him hard! "
"Master Zhong, he has disappeared..."
Just now, Zhong Pinliang was kicked down by Lin Yi. Several of his subordinates focused on whether Zhong Pinliang was okay, but in the blink of an eye, the migrant worker disappeared.
